sources.entry: Tinode - Instant messaging platform. Backend in Go. Clients: Swift iOS, Java Android, JS webapp, scriptable command line; chatbots. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Go

summary.what_it_does: This is a browser frontend for Tinode, a chat platform, and is not usable on its own without a Tinode server. The app is built on React and uses the Tinode JavaScript SDK, which the README says has no external dependencies. It is described as similar to open source WhatsApp or Telegram web apps. The UI is internationalized with React-Intl and is available in about fifteen languages, selected automatically from the browser language or forced with a #?hl=XX URL parameter. An NPM package is available. The README lists features not yet implemented, including end-to-end encryption, mentions, hashtags, link and document previews, location and contact sharing, and video recording. Push notifications are supported with setup instructions given separately.
use_cases: web frontend for a Tinode server
embedding a chat client via NPM
how_to_run: Install and run a Tinode backend server (the README refers to separate installation instructions)
Install the web app from the repository or the NPM package
Open the app in a browser and use the Tinode server connection
Optionally append #?hl=XX to the URL to force a language
notable: Frontend only; pairs with the Tinode backend server
Tinode JavaScript SDK has no external dependencies
UI available in about 15 languages with browser-based language detection
Push notifications supported with separate setup instructions
caveats: Described as work in progress with possible bugs and missing features
Tested only in the latest Chrome and Firefox
